required_content.problem: A formally permitted AI action can still be practically uncontrollable when operators lack time, attention, comprehension, calibrated trust, or an effective intervention path. A dashboard, approval click, nominal human-in-the-loop, or fixed automation level does not establish meaningful control; each can preserve responsibility theater while automation bias, out-of-the-loop degradation, mode confusion, workload saturation, and delayed effects defeat intervention.
required_content.core_mechanism: Meaningful oversight is a resource-bounded control contract: the system must preserve an identified human controller's knowledge, authority, time, observability, and effective intervention path, and must degrade or abstain when that control envelope cannot be maintained. Compile consequential tasks into oversight contracts naming controller, rights, intervention points, deadlines, and safe defaults. Estimate an oversight budget over attention, comprehension time, workload, practice recency, and action latency.
required_content.worked_trace: Implement one bounded high-impact workflow with a versioned oversight contract, workload and deadline gate, mode/authority display, comprehension probe, exercised override, safe hold, intervention receipt, and simulator scenarios for overload, missed alarms, mode confusion, and late intervention. Estimate an oversight budget over attention, comprehension time, workload, practice recency, and action latency. Expose uncertainty, mode, authority, provenance, consequence, and time-to-irreversibility instead of raw telemetry alone. Require active comprehension checks for high-impact transitions.
required_content.failure_boundary: automation bias complacency out-of-the-loop skill decay mode confusion
required_content.evidence_state: This chapter remains Design rationale at argument support. Its contracts, examples, tests, or local artifacts establish only their encoded scope. In the finite model, any consequential transition lacking authority, observability, comprehension, timely intervention, or a reachable safe state is rejected or degraded. The bounded accountability assignment never attributes operational responsibility beyond the authority and effective control recorded in the oversight contract. Loss of observability or intervention capacity cannot silently preserve autonomy.
required_content.non_claims: No chapter claim or evidence state is promoted by this visual. A named mechanism is not proof of correct implementation or useful deployment. A local check or formal model does not establish real-world enforcement. No safety, transfer, state-of-the-art, AGI, or ASI conclusion follows.
required_content.handoff: The next chapter is Human-AI Communication, Persuasion, and Epistemic Security. It takes responsibility for An AI system can preserve internal evidence discipline and still change beliefs, choices, and institutions through selective framing, personalization, synthetic identity, repetition, and amplification.
